items.title: Why Trump is making separatism less appealing in Quebec
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Trump's threats to make Canada the 51st state and the whiplash from his tariff policy have spurred an outpouring of Canadian patriotism in Quebec, a province that regularly threatens to break away and has had two previous referendums on the issue — the most recent in 1995. Maria Cheng explains why support for an independent Quebec is at its lowest level in decades ahead of an October 5 provincial election.
 
#quebec #separatism #canada #trump #politics</article>
